fields.name: update_time
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于当前时间戳）

fields.name: degree
fields.logic: case when degree<0 then null else degree end，源 s01_mem_base_info.degree

fields.name: income
fields.logic: case when income<0 then null else income end，源 s01_mem_base_info.income

fields.name: age
fields.logic: case when age<0 then null else age end，源 s01_mem_base_info.age

fields.name: degree_flag
fields.logic: case when degree>=5 then '3_[5,inf]' when degree>=3 then '2_[3,4)' else '1_[inf,3)'

fields.name: income_flag
fields.logic: case when income>=8 then '3_[8,inf]' when income>=5 then '2_[5,8)' when income>=0 then '1_[0,5)' else '0_-1'

fields.name: age_flag
fields.logic: case when age>=54 then '3_[54,inf]' when age>=38 then '2_[38,54)' else '1_[inf,38)'

fields.name: GD_X_19
fields.logic: 来自 tmp_advance_table：max(cast(json_extract_scalar(inputdata,'$.advance_gd_x_19') as double))；case when c.externalid is not null and GD_X_19 is null then null else GD_X_19

fields.name: GD_X_21
fields.logic: 来自 tmp_advance_table：max(cast(json_extract_scalar(inputdata,'$.advance_gd_x_21') as double))；case when c.externalid is not null and GD_X_21 is null then null else GD_X_21

fields.name: adv_fenzu
fields.desc: 白户判断(advance多头全空→白户置1)
fields.logic: case when c.externalid is not null then case when GD_X_19 is null and GD_X_21 is null then 1 when GD_X_21=1 or (GD_X_21=2 and GD_X_19 !=1) then 1 else 0 end end

fields.name: if_fu_external_data_passed
fields.desc: 复贷外部数据验证是否通过

fields.name: if_in_sx_24h
fields.desc: 是否进入24小时授信流程

fields.name: t0_overdue_amount_1
fields.desc: 第1期 已过应还日 逾期金额

fields.name: t3_overdue_amount_1
fields.desc: 第1期 逾期≥4天 逾期金额

fields.name: t0_should_amt_1
fields.desc: 第1期 已过应还日 应还金额

fields.name: t3_should_amt_1
fields.desc: 第1期 逾期≥4天 应还金额

fields.name: is_t0_window_1
fields.desc: 第1期 已过应还日 窗口标记

fields.name: is_t3_window_1
fields.desc: 第1期 逾期≥4天 窗口标记

fields.name: new_media_source
fields.desc: 新媒体来源分类(Google/tiktok/探知/organic/其它)
fields.logic: case when new_media_source='Google' then '1_Google' when 'tiktok' then '2_tiktok' when '探知' then '3_探知' when 'organic' then '4_organic' else '5_其它'
fields.desc_orig: 新媒体来源分类(Google/tiktok/探知/organic/其它)

fields.name: adv_fenzu_flag
fields.desc: advance多头分组(白户/单头/多头)
fields.logic: case when c.externalid is null then -1 when GD_X_19 is null and GD_X_21 is null then 1 when GD_X_21=1 or (GD_X_21=2 and GD_X_19 !=1) then 2 else 3

fields.name: adv_30d
fields.logic: case when c.externalid is null then '0_-1' when GD_X_19>=5 then '3_[5,inf]' when GD_X_19>=3 then '2_[3,5)' when GD_X_19>=1 then '1_[1,3)' else '-1_-999'

fields.name: adv_730d
fields.logic: case when c.externalid is null then '0_-1' when GD_X_21>=10 then '3_[10,inf]' when GD_X_21>=3 then '2_[3,10)' when GD_X_21>=1 then '1_[1,3)' else '-1_-999'

fields.name: apply_num_total
fields.logic: 行为变量子查询：count(t2.biz_id)，按credit_no且t1.app_time>t2.app_time关联历史笔
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: apply_num_30d
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: issue_num_total
fields.logic: count(case when t2.if_issue=1 then t2.biz_id end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: issue_num_30d
fields.logic: count(case when t2.if_issue=1 and date_diff('day',date(t2.app_time),date(t1.app_time))<=30 then t2.biz_id end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: issue_amount_total
fields.logic: sum(case when t2.if_issue=1 then t2.contract_amount end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: issue_amount_30d
fields.logic: sum(case when t2.if_issue=1 and date_diff('day',date(t2.app_time),date(t1.app_time))<=30 then t2.contract_amount end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: finish_num_total
fields.logic: count(case when t2.finish_time is not null and t1.app_time>t2.finish_time then t2.biz_id end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: finish_num_30d
fields.logic: count(case when t2.finish_time is not null and date_diff('day',date(t2.app_time),date(t1.app_time))<=30 then t2.biz_id end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: to_newissue_days
fields.desc: 距最近一次新客放款间隔天数
fields.logic: max(case when t2.is_reloan='new' and t2.if_issue=1 and t2.finish_time is not null then date_diff('day',date(t2.release_time),date(t1.app_time)) end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: to_lastfinish_days
fields.logic: min(case when t2.finish_time is not null and t1.app_time>t2.finish_time then date_diff('day',date(t2.finish_time),date(t1.app_time)) end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: to_lastfinish_hours
fields.desc: 距上次结清间隔小时数
fields.logic: min(case when t2.finish_time is not null and t1.app_time>t2.finish_time then date_diff('hour',t2.finish_time,t1.app_time) end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: no_apply_num_total
fields.desc: 历史进授信未通过(拒绝)笔数
fields.logic: count(case when t2.if_in_sx=1 and t2.if_sx_passed !=1 then t2.biz_id end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: no_apply_num_30d
fields.desc: 近30天进授信未通过(拒绝)笔数
fields.logic: count(case when t2.if_in_sx=1 and t2.if_sx_passed !=1 and date_diff('day',date(t2.app_time),date(t1.app_time))<=30 then t2.biz_id end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: max_overdue_days
fields.logic: max(case when t2.finish_time is not null and t2.should_time<t2.finish_time then date_diff('day',date(t2.should_time),date(t2.finish_time)) when t2.finish_time is null and t2.should_time<t1.app_time then date_diff('day',date(t2.should_time),date(t1.app_time)) else null end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: max_overdue_days_30d
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: max_overduedays_flag
fields.desc: 最大历史逾期天数分箱
fields.logic: case when max_overdue_days=0 then '1.[0]' when max_overdue_days>=1 and <=30 then '2.[1-30]' when >30 then '3.[31,inf]'
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 max_overdue_days）

fields.name: finish_num_total_flag
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 finish_num_total）

fields.name: finish_num_total_byapp_flag
fields.desc: 按app_group历史结清订单数分箱
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 finish_num_total_byapp）

fields.name: to_lastfinish_days_flag
fields.desc: 距上次结清间隔天数分箱
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 to_lastfinish_days）

fields.name: to_lastfinish_days_byapp_flag
fields.desc: 按app_group距上次结清间隔天数分箱
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 to_lastfinish_days_byapp）

fields.name: to_newissue_days_flag
fields.desc: 距新客放款间隔天数分箱
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 to_newissue_days）

fields.name: to_newissue_days_byapp_flag
fields.desc: 按app_group距新客放款间隔天数分箱
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 to_newissue_days_byapp）

fields.name: if_to_lastfinish_days_over_30
fields.desc: 距上次结清是否超过30天
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于本表 to_lastfinish_days）

fields.name: finish_num_total_byapp
fields.logic: count(case when app_group in (YW/HL/TG/Mexcredo/Cash Vivas/PF/LS/Balam Plata/Toca Lana/Tuna Cash) and finish_time is not null then biz_id end)，按t1.app_group区分
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: to_lastfinish_days_byapp
fields.desc: 按app_group距上次结清间隔天数
fields.logic: min(case when app_group in (上述app) and t2.finish_time is not null and t1.app_time>t2.finish_time then date_diff('day',date(t2.finish_time),date(t1.app_time)) end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: to_newissue_days_byapp
fields.desc: 按app_group距新客放款间隔天数
fields.logic: max(case when app_group in (上述app) and t2.is_reloan='new' and t2.if_issue=1 and t2.finish_time is not null then date_diff('day',date(t2.release_time),date(t1.app_time)) end)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史笔）

fields.name: finish_num
fields.desc: 历史结清次数(>=10归并展示)
fields.logic: case when finish_num>=10 then '10+' else cast(finish_num as varchar)；finish_num=该客同app下当前结清订单及其之前的历史结清笔数 count(distinct t2.biz_id)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 历史结清笔）

fields.name: first_finish_time
fields.desc: 首笔结清日期(新客首笔放款结清时间)
fields.logic: 首笔订单(date(finish_time))，通过tt3子查询取该客同app第一笔(按app_time排序rn=1且is_reloan='new',if_issue=1,finish_time非空)

fields.name: update_tim
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于当前时间戳）

fields.name: finish_user_num
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 结清人群）

fields.name: finish_user_num_5d
fields.desc: 满足5天表现期的结清人数
fields.logic: count(distinct case when date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),now())>=5 then a.biz_id end)；结清满5天(表现期>=5天)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 结清人群）

fields.name: avg_finish_global_limit_5d
fields.desc: 5天表现期结清订单的平均全局额度
fields.logic: avg(case when date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),now())>=5 then finish_global_limit end)；finish_global_limit=avg(coalesce(cast(global_limit as integer),cast(grantcredit_7d_amount as integer)))

fields.name: reloan_apply_user_num_5d
fields.desc: 结清后5天内复借申请人数
fields.logic: count(distinct case when date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),now())>=5 and date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),date(b.app_time))<=5 then a.biz_id end)；表现期>=5天 且 复借窗口<=5天
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 结清人群+复借笔）

fields.name: reloan_apply_num_5d
fields.desc: 结清后5天内复借申请笔数
fields.logic: count(distinct case when date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),now())>=5 and date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),date(b.app_time))<=5 then b.biz_id end)；表现期>=5天 且 复借窗口<=5天
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 复借笔）

fields.name: if_in_sx
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口内进授信笔数(通过率分母)
fields.logic: sum(case when date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),now())>=5 and date_diff('day',date(a.finish_time),date(b.app_time))<5 then b.if_in_sx end)；复借窗口<5天
fields.desc_orig: 5天复借窗口内进授信笔数(通过率分母)

fields.name: if_in_fu_anti_fraud
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 then b.if_in_fu_anti_fraud end)
fields.desc_orig: 5天复借窗口内进反欺诈笔数

fields.name: if_fu_external_data_passed
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口内三方数据通过笔数
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 then b.if_fu_external_data_passed end)
fields.desc_orig: 5天复借窗口内三方数据通过笔数

fields.name: if_sx_passed
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口内授信通过笔数(通过率分子)
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 then b.if_sx_passed end)
fields.desc_orig: 5天复借窗口内授信通过笔数(通过率分子)

fields.name: reloan_global_limit
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口复借订单的平均全局额度
fields.logic: avg(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 then coalesce(cast(b.global_limit as integer),cast(b.grantcredit_7d_amount as integer)) end)

fields.name: if_sx_passed_24h
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口内24h授信通过笔数(24h用信率分子)
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 then b.if_sx_passed_24h end)
fields.desc_orig: 5天复借窗口内24h授信通过笔数(24h用信率分子)

fields.name: if_in_sx_24h
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口内24h进授信笔数(24h用信率分母)
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 then b.if_in_sx_24h end)
fields.desc_orig: 5天复借窗口内24h进授信笔数(24h用信率分母)

fields.name: reloan_amt_5d
fields.desc: 结清后5天内复借放款金额
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 then b.contract_amount end)

fields.name: t0_overdue_amount_1
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口放款 第1期 已过应还日 逾期金额
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 and b.is_t0_window_1=1 then b.t0_overdue_amount_1 end)

fields.name: t3_overdue_amount_1
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口放款 第1期 逾期≥4天 逾期金额
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 and b.is_t3_window_1=1 then b.t3_overdue_amount_1 end)

fields.name: t0_should_amt_1
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口放款 第1期 已过应还日 应还金额
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 and b.is_t0_window_1=1 then b.t0_should_amt_1 end)

fields.name: t3_should_amt_1
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口放款 第1期 逾期≥4天 应还金额
fields.logic: sum(case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 and b.is_t3_window_1=1 then b.t3_should_amt_1 end)

fields.name: T0
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口放款进入T0逾期窗口笔数
fields.logic: count(distinct case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 and b.is_t0_window_1=1 then b.biz_id end)

fields.name: T3
fields.desc: 5天复借窗口放款进入T3逾期窗口笔数
fields.logic: count(distinct case when 表现期>=5天 and 复借窗口<5天 and b.if_issue=1 and b.is_t3_window_1=1 then b.biz_id end)

fields.name: app_status
fields.logic: case when app_version>='1.2.1' and app_channel='56c660de-3549-4482-9ad5-0404eef0d70d' then '置空版本' else '其他版本'

fields.name: msg_status
fields.desc: 消息状态标签(1.2.4及以上置空)
fields.logic: case when app_version>='1.2.4' and app_channel='56c660de-3549-4482-9ad5-0404eef0d70d' then '置空版本' else '其他版本'

fields.name: fd_finishloan_num_main
fields.logic: case when fd_finishloan_num_main>=4 then 4 else fd_finishloan_num_main end

fields.name: repayment_clearing_count_index_tenant
fields.desc: 租户维度结清次数指标

fields.name: one_click_loan_tag
fields.desc: 一键放款标签(测试/对照分组)

fields.name: sxc
fields.desc: 进授信人数(授信节点分母)

fields.name: if_issue_except_loan_fail
fields.desc: 放款笔数(剔除放款失败，高通过组特殊处理)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 标志位）

fields.name: if_in_sx_24h
fields.desc: 是否进入24小时授信流程

fields.name: fd_high_pass_label
fields.desc: 高通过组标签(高通过/非高通过/上线前)
fields.logic: case when fd_high_pass_label=0 then '非高通过组' when =1 then '高通过组' else '高通过组上线前'

fields.name: one_click_loan_tag
fields.desc: 一键放款分组标签(测试组/对照组)
fields.logic: case when one_click_loan_tag='0' then '一键放款对照组' when '1' then '一键放款测试组' else '不符合条件'

fields.name: double_loan
fields.desc: 客群类型(本表固定复贷)
fields.desc_orig: 客群类型(本表固定复贷)

fields.name: update_time
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于当前时间戳）

fields.name: rule_tag
fields.desc: 命中拒绝节点标签(强反/弱反/模型/授信节点/授信拒绝/后置强反/后置弱反/后置模型/三方)
fields.logic: case when if_in_fu_anti_fraud=1 and if_fu_anti_fraud_passed=0 then '强反' when if_in_fu_anti_fraud_weak=1 and if_fu_anti_fraud_weak_passed=0 then '弱反' when if_in_fu_model=1 and if_fu_model_passed=0 then '模型' when if_in_sx=1 and if_sx_passed=0 then '授信节点' when if_in_fu_sx_refuse=1 and if_fu_sx_refuse_passed=0 then '授信拒绝' when if_in_fu_post_anti_fraud_rerun=1 and if_fu_post_anti_fraud_rerun_passed=0 then '后置强反' when if_in_fu_post_weak_anti_fraud_rerun=1 and if_fu_post_weak_anti_fraud_rerun_passed=0 then '后置弱反' when if_in_fu_post_model_reject_rerun=1 and if_fu_post_model_reject_rerun_passed=0 then '后置模型' when if_in_fu_external_data=1 and if_fu_external_data_passed=0 then '三方'
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 各节点标志位）

fields.name: total_cnt
fields.desc: 该维度下申请总人数(分母)
fields.logic: t0子查询 count(distinct biz_id)，WHERE is_reloan='old' and date(create_time)>=2025-02-07

fields.name: rule_name
fields.desc: 命中的具体反欺诈规则名称
fields.logic: 直取 ods.s05_creditx_anti_fraud_record.rule_name，t1关联条件 rule_type='NORMAL' and real_hint='true' and date(create_time)>=2025-02-07

fields.name: cnt
fields.desc: 命中某具体规则的人数
fields.logic: t2子查询 count(distinct t1.biz_id)，按rule_name维度聚合(即进入该规则并命中的去重人数)
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel + ods.s05_creditx_anti_fraud_record）

fields.name: in_cnt
fields.desc: 进入该规则节点的人数(规则集中率分母)
fields.logic: t3子查询 sum(if_in_fu_xxx)，按rule_tag对应节点的进入标志位求和(如强反=sum(if_in_fu_anti_fraud))
fields.source_table: 派生计算（基于 mx.wxs_application_funnel 各节点进入标志位）
